rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Quiet street with a wide grass verge, but steep and homes close on both sides.
reasons: Wide grass verge, a few cars parked

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit back behind the verge on the west and flats face them across the street; mapped dwellings 9-23 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide mown verge and parking lane beside a narrow street; a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street between two junctions; local traffic only.
drivers.convention: One or two cars park along it; no strong convention.

flags: Mapped gate 293 m away has a way round; ignore
sun_shade: Open on the west verge; trees shade the east side and give afternoon shade.

best_section.where: West kerb beside the wide grass verge in front of the grey-roofed houses
